plain: A Canadian UFO researcher named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels about a conversation with Robert Bigelow, a wealthy businessman deeply involved in UFO research. According to Cameron, a man named Timothy Taylor asked Bigelow whether craft had crashed in other countries, and Bigelow said he thought there had been crashes in Russia, China and South America, and that they were being seeded around the world. If true, it would mean crashed craft were deliberately spread across many nations.
